narr: As an outflow boundary moved south across the forecast area, scattered showers and storms developed along it. Some of the storms produced heavy rain causing flash flooding.
ev: Up to four inches of rain fell in a short amount of time causing flash flooding. Several roads were flooded in Irving and Witt. Also, Coffeen Road, and Filmore Trail were briefly flooded.
lsr: FLOODING ON ROUTE 16 IN THE TOWNS OF IRVING AND WITT AND ALSO ON COFFEEN ROAD AND FILLMORE TRAIL.
